summary: Inseego Corp. filed an 8-K reporting its entry into an Asset Purchase Agreement to acquire Nokia's fixed wireless access business. Inseego will pay with 1,163,693 shares of its common stock and warrants to purchase 521,139 shares at $12.89 per share, plus assumption of certain liabilities. The warrants are exercisable for four years post-closing. Nokia agreed to a three-year non-compete and a right of first offer; EBITDA-based reimbursement and profit-sharing provisions apply post-closing. The acquisition expands Inseego's product line in fixed wireless access. Watch for shareholder approval and Nasdaq listing of the new shares; risk-arb focuses on completion and post-close EBITDA triggers.
